summary: Your deepest feelings show up through other people. You may be drawn into intense bonds, power struggles, or closeness that feels consuming. Or you become the one holding all the control.
body: Your deepest feelings show up through other people. You may be drawn into intense bonds, power struggles, or closeness that feels consuming. Or you become the one holding all the control. This can make closeness feel tangled with control, upheaval, or emotional intensity. The see-saw can play out between you and the people you are drawn toward: you want depth, you get intensity, and somewhere in there it becomes about who has the power. Sometimes the intensity is just the wound looking for a familiar shape. The work is letting a bond run deep without turning it into a battle.
gift: At your best: capable of a depth most people never reach.
shadow: The trap: power struggles, jealousy, and merging until you lose yourself.
integration: Let emotional needs and power and transformation cooperate without making either one carry the whole story. Emotional intensity: depth is an asset, volatility a liability.
do: Let depth happen without the battle
Name the power dynamic out loud
Keep your own ground inside closeness
dont: Fight for control to feel safe
